name: Go AMQP message queue backed by SQLite

mentions.name: Go AMQP message queue backed by SQLite
mentions.description: An AMQP message queue written in Go that implements only the most commonly used AMQP features, with one SQLite database per queue. Built as a lightweight, low-configuration alternative to RabbitMQ, which is described as slow, resource hungry, and requiring configuration.
mentions.problem: RabbitMQ is slow, resource hungry, and needs configuration.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I made an AMQP message queue which implements only the most commonly used stuff.

It has one SQLite database per queue.

In golang.

Why? Because Rabbit is slow and resource hungry and needs configuration.
